From: angry.customer@example.com
Subject: Re: Re: Order #42-1138 - STILL HAVEN'T SHIPPED

This is the THIRD time I'm emailing about this order. I ordered the Series-X jacket on October 1st - over two weeks ago - and it still hasn't shipped. I need this jacket for a trip on Friday.

I've been a customer for 4 years. I have the Premier membership that specifically promises guaranteed 3-day shipping. That is clearly not happening here.

I want this resolved TODAY. If it doesn't ship by end of day I want a full refund AND credit for the Premier annual fee. Reply within the hour or I'm filing a chargeback.

questions.prompt: What does the customer most want right now?
How time-critical is this ticket? 1 = can wait a week, 5 = handle in next hour.
How angry is the customer? 1 = calm, 5 = threatening to leave or escalate publicly.
Is the customer threatening a chargeback or public complaint?
Does the customer claim an SLA or shipping guarantee was violated?
